info.title: Partner On-Demand Status Endpoint
info.description: OpenAPI specification for the optional partner-hosted on-demand status endpoint (<partner_status_url>). Used by Cocoon to query the current execution status of a CI run (uid) on demand when a user manually requests a status refresh on the Flutter build dashboard while waiting for results.

servers.description: Partner CI HTTPS server (must use https:// and resolve to a public IP address).

partner_host.description: Public hostname of the Partner CI server.

get.description: Queries the current execution status of a CI run identified by uid. Authenticated via an Ed25519-signed Bearer JWT from Cocoon. Must respond within 30 seconds with a maximum response body size of 768 KB. Because the Flutter build dashboard is public, message summaries and details[].url links MUST NOT contain PII, internal hostnames, or confidential partner secrets.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Unique correlation identifier for the CI execution request (must match data.uid in the Bearer JWT payload).

200.description: Status retrieved successfully. Cocoon updates the task state on the dashboard.

example.message: Running test suites on hardware pool A

400.description: Bad Request — malformed request (e.g., missing uid parameter). Logged as error; surfaces failure to dashboard.

401.description: Unauthorized — authentication error (e.g., invalid or expired Bearer JWT). Logged as error; surfaces failure to dashboard.

403.description: Forbidden — caller is not authorized. Logged as error; surfaces failure to dashboard.

404.description: Not Found — uid not found in the partner CI system. Logged as warning; surfaces uid not found to dashboard.

408.description: Request Timeout — logged as error; surfaces failure to dashboard.

429.description: Too Many Requests — rate limit exceeded; logged as error and surfaces failure to dashboard.

5XX.description: Server Error — logged as error; surfaces failure to dashboard.

cocoonBearerJwt.description: Ed25519-signed Bearer JWT issued by Cocoon. The decoded JWT header conforms to #/components/schemas/JwtHeader and the decoded JWT payload conforms to #/components/schemas/PartnerStatusJwtPayload.

JwtHeader.title: Decoded JWT Header
JwtHeader.description: JWS header parameters for Ed25519-signed tokens.

alg.description: Cryptographic signing algorithm. Must be 'EdDSA' (Ed25519 per RFC 8037).

kid.description: Key ID identifying the Ed25519 public key in Cocoon's JWKS endpoint.

PartnerStatusJwtPayload.title: Decoded Partner Status Bearer JWT Payload (v1)
PartnerStatusJwtPayload.description: Decoded Bearer JWT claims sent by Cocoon in the Authorization header of GET <partner_status_url>?uid=<uid>.

iss.description: Issuer claim identifying Cocoon as the caller.

version.description: API schema version of the payload.

uid.description: Unique correlation identifier for the CI execution request (matches the uid query parameter).

PartnerStatusResponse.title: Partner On-Demand Status Response (v1)
PartnerStatusResponse.description: Current CI execution status returned by GET <partner_status_url>?uid=<uid>.

message.description: Optional Markdown-formatted summary of the CI run. Must not contain PII, internal hostnames, or confidential partner secrets.

name.description: Name of the test suite or device target.

url.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL for test execution logs or details. Must not contain PII, internal hostnames, or confidential partner secrets.

ExecutionStatus.title: Execution Status
ExecutionStatus.description: Allowed non-terminal (in_progress) and terminal execution status values.

ErrorResponse.title: Error Response
ErrorResponse.description: Standard JSON error response body returned on HTTP 4xx and 5xx responses.
